Ape Escape.name: Ape Escape
Ape Escape.summary: Ape Escape is a single-player 3D platformer released in 1999 for the Playstation. Using the analog stick, you must capture apes that have escaped throughout time to stop them from screwing up the fabric of time and space.

Arcana Heart 3.name: Arcana Heart 3
Arcana Heart 3.summary: In Arcana Heart 3, chaos is erupting in Japan. Planar rifts are appearing in various locations around the country and it is suspected that the Drexler Institute, a player in the Great War many years ago and creator of the Divine Celestial Weapon, is involved. There is a rumor circulating that if one gets their hands on a celestial stone from a rift, their wishes will be granted. Their power draws many young women to search for them, either to seal them away or in hopes that the rumors are true. Each has their own reasons for the hunt, and they won't allow anyone stand in their way, enemy…or friend alike.

Janline R.name: Janline R
Janline R.summary: Janline R is a Japanese mahjong game developed and published by Recom for the PlayStation 3. Released as an upgraded version of the Xbox 360 title Janline, the game adds 3D avatars, USB camera support and various gameplay improvements. Players compete in online and offline mahjong matches using standard Japanese mahjong rules.

Obut Petanque 2.name: Pétanque Master 2
Obut Petanque 2.summary: French lawn bowling at its finest.

Rocksmith 2014.name: Rocksmith 2014
Rocksmith 2014.summary: Plug any electric guitar or bass into your PC, Mac, Xbox 360, or PlayStation 3, Playstation 4 or Xbox One and join over 1.5 million people who have learned to play guitar with award-winning Rocksmith method. Learn to play guitar in 60 days. Get started, now!

Root Double - Before Crime - After Days.name: Root Double: Before Crime * After Days - Xtend Edition
Root Double - Before Crime - After Days.summary: Rescue squad captain Watase Kasasagi wakes up without his memories in the middle of his most critical mission yet-- a nuclear meltdown at a research facility. In an unfamiliar place and without his years of training, he must rescue the survivors and escape... but could the key to the mystery behind the incident lie in the mind of Natsuhiko Tenkawa, a seemingly ordinary student?

World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 2014
World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014.summary:
Pro Evolution Soccer 2014 (PES 2014) is a football simulation game developed by Konami. Released in 2013, it is part of the long-running Pro Evolution Soccer series and introduces a new engine, updated mechanics, and expanded features across multiple platforms.

PES 2014 centers gameplay around realistic ball physics, player motion, and team dynamics. It introduces the Motion Animation Stability System (M.A.S.S.) to enhance physical interactions between players, making tackles, collisions, and positioning more lifelike. The game also features a morale system where crowd influence and individual performances affect team behavior on the pitch.

The Player ID system, first introduced in PES 2013, is expanded to cover more star players and now replicates full squad behaviors to reflect real-world playing styles. A new Combination Plan allows users to coordinate tactical plays among three or more players, enabling more diverse and strategic attacking options.

Additional features include the ability to switch clubs or coach national teams in Master League, create third and fourth kits (with some official options), and play the UEFA Europa League in a dedicated mode.
